(C) Blanching vascular abnormalities - Vascular changes, including Raynaud's phenomenon, are a hallmark of SSc.
(D) Hypercoagulable state - Patients with SSc are at an increased risk of developing thrombotic events due to the underlying vascular and inflammatory changes.
